title: Charging Solutions for Electric Vehicles Using Solar-Powered Inductive Lanes
content: This paper presents the design and partial implementation of a sustainable electric vehicle (EV) charging system utilizing an inductive charging lane powered by solar panels. The proposed model enables EVs to charge while in motion using embedded coils and wireless energy transfer, thereby aiming to eliminate range anxiety and enhance green mobility. A prototype is under development, focusing on solar integration, proximity sensing, and intelligent energy management. System testing and performance evaluation are yet to be conducted. The work lays a foundation for future implementation of scalable and eco-friendly transportation infrastructure.
